common.tagline: Clear work. Safe pay. Proof that travels.
common.closingLine: On Sajha Kaam, you're hired for your work, not your surname, your contacts or your price.
common.sampleData: Sample data. All people, jobs and payments are fictional.
common.comingNext: This screen is being built next. It will work in both languages.
common.offline: You are offline. Your drafts are saved on this phone; try again when you are connected.

lang.label: Language
lang.chooseSub: You can change it any time with the ने | EN button at the top.

entry.chooseRole: What do you want to do?
entry.clientSub: Post a small, clear job. Pick the best work, blind.
entry.workerSub: Win a fair first paid job and keep the proof.
entry.browseGuest: Just look at the job board
entry.promise: Picked for your work, not your name.

auth.emailHelp: Used only to sign in and send you notices. Never shown to the other person.
auth.displayNameHelpWorker: Clients see this only after they have picked your work.
auth.displayNameHelpClient: Your name or your business name.
auth.consentCheck: I have read what Sajha Kaam collects and why, and I agree.
auth.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
auth.ageRequired: You must be 18 or older to work on Sajha Kaam.

consent.title: What we collect and why
consent.email: Email: to sign in and send you notices.
consent.name: Display name: shown to the other person at the right time.
consent.skills: Skills: to show you matching jobs.
consent.never: We never ask for your photo, caste, religion, age, gender or citizenship number.

board.title: Kaam Board
board.subtitle: Fixed price. No bidding. The best work wins, judged blind.
board.pahiloHelp: For workers with 0 to 2 confirmed jobs.
board.empty: No open jobs match. Try another skill, or turn off the Pahilo Kaam filter.

card.doneWhenHelp: Each item is a yes or no a stranger could check.
card.payoutNote: Paid directly to your Khalti. Sajha Kaam never holds money.
card.notFound: This job is not open any more.

post.title: New Kaam Card
post.prompt: Describe the job in Nepali or English
post.needsClarificationHelp: Answer these before you post, so nobody argues later.
post.notPostedYet: Nothing is posted until you tap Save & post.
post.blocked: This kind of work is not allowed on Sajha Kaam.
post.postedOpen: Posted. Your card is on the Kaam Board for 48 hours.
post.pendingReview: Sent for a quick check by Sajha Kaam. It goes on the board after approval.

myCards.title: My cards
myCards.empty: No cards here yet. Post your first Kaam Card.

review.title: Fair Pick: blind review
review.intro: Names, photos, gender, age and home district stay hidden until you pick. Score the work against the checklist.
review.notScored: Context only. Not part of the score.
review.scoreHelp: Give 1 to 3 stars for each checklist item. Everyone is scored on the same items.
review.attest: I don't personally know any applicant.
review.tieTitle: Tie at the top. Choose one and say why.
review.tieReason: Reason (saved in the Fair Pick record)
review.noCards: No cards are ready for review yet.

work.title: My work
work.empty: You have not applied yet. Find a Pahilo Kaam job on the board.
work.offer: You were picked! Open the job to accept or decline.
work.nextFind: Find your first job on the board.

passport.title: Work Passport
passport.disclaimer: A record of work done on Sajha Kaam. Not a government ID, work permit, tax document or legal identity.
passport.empty: Your first client-confirmed job will appear here.
passport.qrTitle: Show this QR to a new client
passport.qrHelp: It opens your public Passport page. It shows only the records you make public.
passport.qrA11y: QR code for your public Work Passport page
passport.shareHelp: The link shows only the records you pick, and stops working after 7 days or when you cancel it.
passport.useAnywhereHelp: Copy these lines into LinkedIn, Upwork or your CV.
passport.summaryLine2: Hired blind, for my work, through a fair open process.
passport.deleteAll: Delete my Passport and personal data
passport.deleteConfirm: This cannot be undone. Your records, share links and name are deleted and you will be signed out.
passport.signedOk: Signed by Sajha Kaam ✓ checked on this phone

help.title: Help
help.body: Something wrong with a job? A person at Sajha Kaam will look at it. You can open a case at any time after a job starts.
help.liteHelp: Text first, no animation, fewer pictures. Good for slow data and older phones.

errors.network: Can't reach Sajha Kaam. Check your internet and try again.
errors.needsBackend: This needs the Sajha Kaam server. Start the backend and set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL.
errors.conflict: This step is not possible right now. Refresh and try again.

manage.title: Your Kaam Card
manage.openWaiting: Collecting applications. Blind review opens when the window closes.
manage.revealExplain: You picked Applicant {{letter}}. Revealing shows their name and sends them the offer.
manage.revealed: You hired {{name}}. Waiting for them to accept.
manage.declinedNext: The worker declined (no penalty). The next-highest applicant is ready to reveal.
manage.expired: No one applied in time. You can extend the window once.
manage.receiptHelp: Anyone can open it and recompute every step on their own phone. Applicants appear as letters only.
manage.applicantsHelp: Names stay hidden until you tap Reveal & hire, so the pick is about the work only (Fair Pick).

apply.title: Apply
apply.sampleHelp: Describe past work or do the short sample asked for. No CV, photo or age.
apply.leakFound_one: We found {{count}} detail that could identify you.
apply.leakFound_other: We found {{count}} details that could identify you.
apply.consent: The client sees only my sample and answers, to choose fairly.
apply.noIdentifying: My sample contains no names or logos that identify me.
apply.imageNote: Leak Guard cannot read names inside images.
apply.sent: Application sent. You'll hear back after the window closes.
apply.reason_pahilo_kaam_only_beginners: This Pahilo Kaam job is for workers with 0 to 2 confirmed jobs.
apply.reason_above_level_cap: This job is above your Kaam Path level. Finish more confirmed jobs to unlock it.
apply.reason_too_many_active_applications: You already have 5 active applications. Wait for a result first.
apply.already: You already applied to this job.
apply.closed: Applications for this job are closed.

workroom.title: Workroom
workroom.offerTitle: You were picked for this job
workroom.khaltiHelp: Create a payment request in the Khalti app and paste its link. The client pays it directly to you.
workroom.locked: Terms are locked. Changes need both of you.
workroom.needAll: Tick every item to confirm, or request a revision.
workroom.revisionNote: Say what is missing for each unticked item.
workroom.payExplain: Pay through the worker's own Khalti link. The money goes straight to them. Sajha Kaam never holds it.
workroom.waitingPayment: Waiting for the client to pay.
workroom.clientMarkedPaid: The client says they paid. Check your Khalti app.
workroom.waitingWorker: Waiting for the worker to confirm the money arrived.
workroom.done: Done. Paid and confirmed by both. The job is in the Work Passport.
workroom.providerFees: Payment-provider fees are set by Khalti and Stripe. Check them in the Khalti app.
workroom.messagesLocked: Messages open once the card is locked.
workroom.warn_off_platform: This asks to move to personal chat or for photos. Keep work talk here so there is a shared record.
workroom.caseOpened: Case opened. A person at Sajha Kaam will look at it.

notif.offer: You were picked for “{{title}}”! Accept or decline.
notif.accepted: The worker accepted “{{title}}”. The card is locked.
notif.declined: The worker declined “{{title}}”. Applicant {{next_letter}} is next.

notif.revision_requested: The client asked for a revision on “{{title}}”.
notif.confirmed: The client confirmed your work on “{{title}}”.
notif.payment_marked: The client says they paid for “{{title}}”. Check Khalti.
notif.passport_issued: “{{title}}” is now in your Work Passport.
notif.feedback: Feedback for “{{title}}”: your sample met {{met}} of {{total}} items.
notif.card_pending_review: “{{title}}” is waiting for a quick Sajha Kaam check.
notif.card_approved: “{{title}}” was approved and is on the board.
notif.card_changes_requested: Sajha Kaam asked for a change to “{{title}}”: {{reason}}

admin.title: Review queue
admin.empty: No cards are waiting for a check.

stress.title: Stress Test
stress.help: Two careful readers check your card: a worker afraid of being blamed, and a client afraid of an unusable 'done'. Advice only: it never changes your price or deadline.
stress.meter: Clarity: {{before}} of {{total}} checklist items testable → {{after}} of {{total}} with these fixes
stress.noIssues: No problems found. Every checklist item can be checked yes or no.

mauri.offline: You're offline. Mauri is resting; your drafts are safe on this phone.
mauri.hello: Namaste! I'm Mauri. I'll show you the way.
